questions.q: Across the Apexa range, which best describes the CPU options?
o: From Intel N97/Celeron J6412 up to Core i3 and i5
questions.e: The same Apexa chassis scales from N97/J6412 for light retail up to Core i3/i5 for software-heavy sites.

questions.q: What screen sizes does the Posbank BigPos kiosk come in?
questions.e: BigPos is offered in 21.5" and 27". (The Mazic K kiosk is the 15.6"/21.5" line.)

questions.q: Why is 'fanless' a key selling point for Posbank POS terminals?
o: It makes them cheaper to ship
No moving parts means higher reliability, silent running and no dust/grease ingress
It removes the need for an SSD
questions.e: Fanless design eliminates the fan as a failure point and a dust/grease trap, giving longer life and silent operation.
